negative_snippets:
This is hands down the worst hotel I have ever stayed in. Calling this place a hotel is an insult to real hotels.

The room was filthy, poorly maintained, and smelled terrible. Bedsheets were dirty, the bathroom looked like it hadn’t been cleaned in ages, and everything felt broken or neglected. I didn’t feel safe or comfortable for a single minute.

The staff were shockingly rude and completely unhelpful. Any request felt like a burden to them. Zero professionalism, zero respect for guests.

There was constant noise, no peace, and no basic facilities working properly. I paid good money for stress, discomfort, and frustration.

This hotel ruined my stay and wasted my time and money. I would strongly warn anyone thinking of booking here: DON’T. Save yourself from this nightmare.
